name: Salesforce
summary: Changed in 2026: since Spring '26 you can't create new Connected Apps (unless Support enables it). Build an External Client App instead. Selling through AppExchange adds a paid security review that takes weeks.

composio.note: Composio-managed works for connecting customer orgs. Some customer admins restrict uninstalled apps, which blocks any app, managed or yours.

capabilities.label: Read & write CRM data via API
capabilities.why: Create an ECA in your Developer Edition org. Customer orgs can authorize it

capabilities.label: Listed on AppExchange / ISV distribution
capabilities.why: Partner Program, packaging, and a paid security review

gates.label: AppExchange security review
gates.plain: Salesforce's security team tests your app before listing. Paid.

steps.title: Get a free Developer Edition org
steps.human: Sign up and verify your email

steps.title: Create an External Client App
steps.detail: Setup → External Client App Manager → New. Enable OAuth, the scopes (api, refresh_token) and the callback URL (Composio BYO: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback). Connected Apps can't be created by default since Spring '26.
steps.agent: Prepare the settings and policies (PKCE on, refresh token policy)
steps.human: Create it in Setup and copy the consumer key and secret

steps.title: Plan for 2026 OAuth security changes
steps.detail: Refresh-token idle TTL is capped at 30 days (production from Nov 4, 2026). Username-password and user-agent flows retire Feb 20, 2027.
steps.agent: Use the web-server flow with PKCE and refresh proactively

steps.title: Join the Salesforce Partner Program (AppExchange)
steps.detail: Needed to package and list your app.
steps.human: Enroll your company and accept the agreements

steps.title: Package the ECA in a 2GP managed package
steps.detail: AppExchange guidance requires ECAs for new integrations, packaged for distribution.
steps.agent: Set up the packaging and the scanner runs

steps.title: AppExchange security review
steps.detail: Salesforce's Product Security team tests the solution and your external endpoints. A failed review means fix and resubmit.
steps.agent: Run Code Analyzer/Checkmarx and DAST scans; write the false-positive docs
steps.human: Pay the review fee and submit
steps.cost: Security review fee (paid; check current Partner pricing)

launchToday: Use Composio-managed Salesforce to connect customer orgs today.
Or create your own ECA in a Developer org today. Customer orgs can authorize it straight away (subject to their admin policies).
rejections: Security review: scanner findings with no false-positive documentation
Insecure external endpoints (TLS, auth) found by DAST
Using legacy flows (username-password) that are being retired

blockers.problem: “New Connected App” is missing or blocked
blockers.fix: Expected since Spring '26. Create an External Client App, or ask Salesforce Support to enable Connected App creation.

blockers.problem: OAUTH_APPROVAL_ERROR_GENERIC / app blocked in the customer org
blockers.fix: The customer's admin restricts uninstalled apps. They need to install or allow your app, or approve it under Connected Apps OAuth Usage.

blockers.problem: Customers get logged out after a month
blockers.fix: Refresh tokens now expire after 30 days idle. Refresh on a schedule.

uncertain: The current security review fee and turnaround aren't on the cited pages. Both are estimates.
Discovery advertises a dynamic client registration endpoint. Whether it's usable for third-party apps is untested.
